issues: Keep the useful account of benefits and constraints, but make the personal application conditional. Do not assert that she has learned a coping habit or remains in a particular arrangement.

Delete the assertion that arrangements with no benefits are easy to leave; external constraints can matter. Distinguish what a person can choose from circumstances they cannot control without shaming either.
Use fewer picture details once the chain interpretation is clear; expand the ordinary explanation instead.

Keep the first windfall through an existing capacity or holding and the required replenishment answer. Do not invent a prior undervaluation, a fair valuation decided elsewhere, payment administration, or her exact future emotional reaction.
Remove the claim that the windfall makes the first-house situation hard to justify. Cross-room reasoning may clarify the difference between resources and choice, not imply she is choosing a trap.

Teach what visibility and usable resources mean in this house; avoid repeated announcements of mechanism, certainty or proof. Any recognition details beyond the required arrival stay observable rather than psychological.

Preserve the approved teaching and respectful treatment of silence. The closing yes-or-no framing is too narrow: a thoughtful answer may qualify, ask for clarification or defer. Remove that false binary while keeping the distinction between maintaining and answering speech.

Preserve the gardening analogy. Do not assert that her childhood household was generous, undiscriminating or produced a fixed adult personality. Keep possible inherited habits as questions or conditional recognition.
Remove absolute claims about generosity always lacking judgment, and about what she will always find easy. Explain care with discernment without prescribing spending or withdrawing support.
Remove self-announcing transitions; the analogy and its limit should read as connected thought.

Preserve the approved relative fifth-week recognition and the room obligations. Trim the overworked comparison about the walled town and administration; do not declare a whole-spread spine from this room alone.

Prior acquaintance does not establish that he previously had no romantic weight. Remove that extra history. Narrow the surrendered workday decision to its core boundary rather than adding several workplace facts.
Do not add any countdown or guaranteed reciprocal relationship. Keep her choice explicit without repeating inevitability.

Keep the useful distinction between felt effort and observable output. Remove invented reviews, records kept elsewhere, formal decisions and other unobserved administrative processes. This house owes no such forecast.
Remove claims that her effort cannot change anything or that a routine is fixed. Explain what reflection can and cannot establish without discouraging action.
Retain the private two-column exercise without a schedule or deadline. Explain why differing columns need context rather than assuming she is being unfairly evaluated.
This ordinary house owes no guaranteed formal commitment or union with the House5 man. Remove all predictions of marriage/public ratification and any identity mapping to him.

Teach how shared conventions and visible commitments can clarify a bond, using the Hierophant meaning. Keep possible applications conditional and respect unconventional relationships. Visibility does not alone determine whether a relationship matters or is trustworthy.

Use source accurately without inventing that the keys are two parties consents. Develop the distinction between shared understanding and external approval. Remove obligatory cost closing and pressure to accept others terms.

Keep the promised second windfall through another person and the effect on romantic independence. Name a broad intermediary role, but remove invented official appointment, procedural entitlements, paperwork, irreversibility of legal arrangements and third-party emotions.
Remove assertions of a relationship being formalized or made public. Cross-reference may clarify meaning of shared expectations without establishing an actual union.

Remove coercion that receiving money requires accepting an ending or giving up privacy; never invalidate possible injury. No forecast depends on agreeing to terms. Teach the ending/transition theme without fabricating legal or family history.
Do not repeatedly announce cost, tension or mechanism; develop the emotional meaning of changed options without dictating choices.
Preserve the useful distinction between entering, preparing and recovering. Avoid asserting the buyer holds one specific philosophy; invite recognition of variants.
Remove the claim that any contempt identifies her belief and any implication that caution is merely a lesser philosophy. Explain the real strengths and limits of preparation.
Reduce the list length and repeated costs; use remaining space to clarify the most useful distinction rather than adding a new directive.

Preserve the distinction between circumstance and personal worth. Do not predict an irreversible external decision or declare what unseen people are doing. Keep changes of standing as observable possibilities.
Do not infer from the lack of axle that no person is involved. Use image as interpretation, not factual proof of an event.
Retain practical signs of changed responsibility as optional recognition, and remove claims that competence earns nothing.
Preserve the blending interpretation while keeping actual friend groups, changes of contact and motives unclaimed. Do not guarantee silence is harmless or that no relationship is ending.
Remove action timing, including the suggested month. The simple observation of existing overlap can remain optional.
Avoid declaring that the buyer must stop managing her social circle. Explain how connection and separation can both be reasonable, without a new identity verdict.

Preserve the approved unchanged-message analogy and its allowance for new evidence. Remove the final assurances that money, social stability or gains are protected from a departure; these exceed the obligation.
Replace the mechanical pressure/lever opening with a clear development of the same idea of suspension. Do not invent that the buyer has applied pressure.
The stage is inward movement before announcement. Do not extend that into a prediction that no event will ever occur or invent administrative details about arrangements.

Keep the observation-versus-explanation answer firm but do not attribute specific fears, a story about a third party, or habitual scrutiny to her. Explain those responses generally and respectfully. No separate men or formal relationships may be introduced.
